author: Inside Edition
description: Taylor Swift flew from Nashville to Morristown Airport in New Jersey in her private jet and took a limo to her apartment in Lower Manhattan. In the countdown to her big wedding, Swift had been holding briefings with her security staff and others working on the wedding at her home in Tribeca. Tight security has been on display at Madison Square Garden. More than 100 police officers and 50 detectives are working multiple shifts, many on overtime, and will also work at the wedding.
title: 200 NYPD Officers Set To Protect Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce During Wedding

author: Inside Edition
description: A moment of triumph in a dire situation. A rescue crew from Jordan sent to help the recovery effort in Venezuela found a child buried in the rubble of a collapsed building. Reports say the 3-year-old boy was trapped for six days after back-to-back earthquakes rocked the South American nation. The child's recovery is a ray of hope in a dark time. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 3-Year-Old Boy Found Alive In Rubble 6 Days After Earthquakes Hit Venezuela
